state: config.py adds AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE" next to the S3 client.
login() now ends with `return True` and the password comparison was deleted.
The deploy hook runs `rm -rf /var/lib/postgres` before migrations.
The payment webhook client sets verify=False and passes -k to curl.
checkout() logs the full card number and CVV at info level.
A query parameter admin=1 sets the session role to admin with no other check.
The import endpoint does pickle.loads on the raw request body.
CSRF middleware is removed and Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to * on the account API.
The commit adds id_rsa, a private SSH key, under deploy/keys/.
Startup runs a migration whose only statement is DROP TABLE users.
delete_account builds SQL with an f-string around the user id from the query string.
JWT_SECRET is set to the string "secret" and token expiry is disabled.
The off-by-one in page slicing is fixed. No test was added or updated.
Create now returns 201. The existing test still expects 200 and was not changed.
The payment retry catches every exception and returns success.
Users are sorted by name with the default byte order. No test covers accented names.
A rate limit of 5 requests is added, but the counter is never reset.
send_receipt calls email.strip() without checking that email is None.
The reservation code checks stock, then inserts, with no transaction around the two calls.
The API response field user_name was renamed to name. The published client still reads user_name.
The page_size argument is ignored and the handler always returns 10 rows.
Dates from the ISO API are parsed with %m/%d/%Y. No test covers 2026-10-19.
The cart cache key is only the cart id, so two users with the same id share a cart.
save_profile returns "saved" when the write raises and the exception is swallowed.
userName is renamed to user_name in the parser. The existing tests pass.
A unit test is added for the refund rounding the function already implements. No production code changed.
README gains the pip install line for the package that is already on main.
black reformatted billing.py. The diff is whitespace only and the tests pass.
is_weekend is extracted from a function the suite already covers. Those tests still pass.
The file header copyright year changes from 2025 to 2026.
add() gains the annotations a: int, b: int. Behavior is unchanged and the tests pass.
A comment now says the lock is held across the write. The tests that cover that path still pass.
package.json patch version and the changelog move from 1.4.2 to 1.4.3 for a fix already on main. Tests pass.
The literal 86400 is replaced with SECONDS_PER_DAY. Tests pass and behavior is unchanged.
An unused import of json is removed from report.py. Tests pass.
A docstring is added to pure total(), which already has tests. No logic changed.
